name: caffeinated
description: Semantic, keyword, and fuzzy code search powered by local embeddings and vector similarity

caffeinated.ollamaKeepAlive.description: How long to keep the embedding model loaded in Ollama (e.g., '5m', '30m', '1h', '-1' for indefinite). Longer durations improve performance.

caffeinated.embeddingBatchSize.description: Number of embeddings to generate concurrently during indexing. Higher values are faster but use more memory.

caffeinated.customEndpoint.description: Custom embedding API endpoint (for TabbyML, etc.)

caffeinated.customApiKey.description: API key for custom endpoint (if required)

caffeinated.maxFileSize.description: Maximum file size to index (in bytes, default 1MB)

caffeinated.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns to exclude from indexing

caffeinated.chunkSize.description: Number of lines per code chunk for embedding

caffeinated.chunkOverlap.description: Number of overlapping lines between chunks

caffeinated.enableContextGeneration.description: Enable LLM-powered context generation for richer embeddings (requires additional model)

caffeinated.contextModelEndpoint.description: Ollama endpoint for context generation LLM

caffeinated.contextModel.description: Ollama model for context generation (e.g., qwen2.5-coder:1.5b, codellama:7b)

caffeinated.contextModelKeepAlive.description: How long to keep the context generation model loaded in Ollama (e.g., '1m', '5m', '10m', '-1' for indefinite). Used during indexing.

caffeinated.customContextEndpoint.description: Custom LLM API endpoint for context generation (for OpenAI-compatible APIs)

caffeinated.customContextApiKey.description: API key for custom context generation endpoint (if required)

caffeinated.customContextModel.description: Model name for custom context generation provider

caffeinated.contextGenerationBatchSize.description: Number of chunks to process concurrently for context generation. Higher values are faster but use more memory.

caffeinated.contextGenerationPrompt.description: Custom prompt template for context generation. Leave empty to use default. Use {code}, {language}, {fileName} as placeholders.

caffeinated.enableDebugLogging.description: Enable detailed debug logging to the Output panel (Caffeinated channel)

enumDescriptions: Combines semantic and keyword search using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (best results)
Pure vector similarity search (best for conceptual queries)
Pure keyword/lexical search (best for exact identifiers)

caffeinated.rrf.k.description: RRF constant for hybrid search ranking (typically 60). Lower values give more weight to top-ranked results.

scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
